Deviation from the reviewer's wording: the Greece/Epirus fix is two occupation pairs (Greece 395-397, Epirus 397-401) rather than one start with two ends, which the validator flags as an unpaired end.

Thin items worked beyond the four unapplied findings: Hunnic withdrawal 401 -> 398 (conf 2); Avar delta 561 raised to 2; Singidunum 588 raised to 2; 626 gain of Colchis and Iberia lowered to 1; 469 Crimea counterpart huns -> nobody; wrong Spania quotation (592 ledger note and keyframe) corrected; notes added to the Gepid, Ghassanid, Lazica and Rhodes events.
The 534-548 Moorish contest still names 'Mauri (Moorish tribes)'; kingdom-of-the-aures (539 loss, 544 gain to the empire) and kingdom-of-altava now exist if a later pass wants to name them.
